body.x: SUPERNOVA (CEO Sang-min Lee) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.

SUPERNOVA develops innovative education and service robots that can be used in everyday life. Their first product is ‘HUENIT’, an AI modular robot arm, which had the honor of winning the CES 2023 Innovation Award. They are conducting R&D on STEAM education content utilizing HUENIT and aims to provide fun educational content integrated with AI, robotics, and software. Going further, they are developing a hand drip system and ice cream robot system utilizing HUENIT, and the company explains that within 1~2 years, HUENIT will be utilized in everyday life.

HUENIT, showcased at the trade show, is a high-precision AI modular robot arm for makers and automated systems. It supports AI vision, laser sculpting, 3D printing, robot grippers, writing, and drawing functions, and even has customizing modules. It supports various development environments, such as Visual Programming (block coding), Python, Arduino and (C++) programming.

In addition, it can learn and experience the entire process of AI training utilizing Tensorflow (AI NPU installed in HUENIT camera module). Even beginners can easily learn and utilize all of the functions through the HUENIT SW platform.

The HUENIT Barista, introduced at the same time, is a hand drip robot system that can control the temperature, flow rate, extraction pattern, extraction volume, and extraction time, which determines the taste of hand drip coffee, in the same way as real barista. SUPERNOVA explained that, “HUENIT Barista has the strengths of being able to provide better hand drip recipe control than hand drip robot systems which use existing industrial robots, a convenient maintenance system, and high space efficiency, all while being 3~5 times cheaper.”

They also explained the product development background. An official emphasized that, “HUENIT was developed to revolutionize STEAM education and F&B robot services. You can provide various educational content, on topics like AI, SW, robotics, and science, using small robot arms with industrial level precision. Furthermore, it can provide automation systems in the field of F&B (hand drip coffee, soft-serve ice cream, cocktail making, etc).”

Based on such uses, HUENIT has succeeded in pre-sales exceeding 820,000 USD through global crowd funding, and aims to reach over 10 million USD in sales by targeting the Korean B2G education market and global STEAM education market.

An official explained the background of their participation in the trade show, saying, “We will introduce HUENIT’s special functions and strengths and show that various issues on industrial sites can solved with HUENIT through our participation in CES 2023,” and said that, “In particular, we plan to reveal our new product, HUENIT Barrista, for the first time at CES.”

They added on that, “In the future, we plan to develop a medium-sized robot arm, which will have a higher payload and be more than twice as big as HUENIT. We plan to provide more automation services through the cooperation of HUENIT, the small-sized robot arm, and the medium-sized robot arm.”

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
